# FileItem

`FileItem` — one 56px row representing a file or a folder in a `FileUpload` list or as a standalone attachment on a note, comment or message. Anatomy (`start`, `label`, `description`, `end`) is structured for reuse: a 20px lead status/type indicator, middle-truncated name with a full-name tooltip, one status/meta line, and at most one removal control (preceded by Retry on `error`).

**Import:** `import { FileItem } from '@/components';`

**Source:** `design-system/src/components/forms-and-inputs/FileItem/FileItem.jsx`

**Stories:** `design-system/src/components/forms-and-inputs/FileItem/FileItem.stories.jsx` — Overview, Queued, Uploading0, Uploading40, Uploading80, DoneRemove, DoneDelete, ErrorWithRetry, FolderUploading, FolderDone, ReadOnly, Disabled, LongName, Interactive

**Storybook page:** `design-system/src/components/forms-and-inputs/FileItem/FileItem.mdx`

**Motion:** change `appearance.fast` · progress `linear`. Read the tokens through `--ds-motion-*`; see Foundations › Expression › Motion.

## Usage

Use `FileItem` inside `FileUpload`'s `children` slot to represent every chosen file or folder, or standalone to display attachments on session notes, comments, and messages. Every row stays locked to `--file-item-height` (`56px`) across `queued`, `uploading`, `done`, and `error` so a list never shifts height as uploads progress.

## Motion

FileItem reads these motion tokens and no literal duration or curve.

| Event | Transition | Tokens | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| change | Update a value or state | `--ds-motion-appearance-fast` | Row state and action hover transitions. |
| progress | Load content | `--ds-motion-linear` | The uploading ProgressRing fills clockwise with the upload. |

## Alternatives

- For choosing or dropping files from a device, use `FileUpload`.
- For overall progress across a checklist or page section rather than a row's lead slot, use `ProgressBar`.
- For a compact inline token representing a person or category rather than an attachment, use `Tag`.

## Best practices

### Match the removal mode to whether the file is already saved. {#match-the-removal-mode-to-whether-the-file-is-already-saved}

Use `removal="cancel"` while uploading and `removal="remove"` in an unsaved form so an accidental click is reversible, and reserve `removal="delete"` for saved attachments where removing deletes stored data.

Do: Saved attachment uses trash and asks to confirm before deleting.
Don't: Saved attachment removed immediately with an X and no confirmation.

### State both the cause and the fix on upload errors. {#state-both-the-cause-and-the-fix-on-upload-errors}

Write `error` as one sentence naming why the upload failed and what the person can do next alongside `Retry`.

Do: Names the limit and the next step beside Retry.
Don't: Leaves the user guessing why Retry will or will not work.

### Represent a chosen folder as one folder row with its file count. {#represent-a-chosen-folder-as-one-folder-row-with-its-file-count}

Keep the file list scannable by collapsing a dropped or picked folder into one `kind="folder"` row that reports its item count in `meta`.

Do: One folder row with its file count in meta.
Don't: Folder row hides how many files were included.

## Accessibility

- **Full file name stays accessible.** Visually truncated names expose a single unbroken accessible text node for screen readers and Links, and reveal the full name in a `Tooltip` on hover or focus.
- **Determinate upload progress.** While `status="uploading"`, `ProgressRing` announces `role="progressbar"` with `aria-label="Uploading <name>"` and `aria-valuenow`.
- **Named per-file actions.** Cancel, Remove, and Delete `IconButton` controls include the file name in their accessible label (`"Remove zoom_0.mp4"`, `"Delete signed_consent.pdf"`) so screen-reader users can distinguish rows in a batch.
- **Keyboard-accessible delete confirmation.** `removal="delete"` opens a Base UI `Popup` dialog that traps Escape and outside clicks to cancel cleanly and returns focus to the trigger.

## Parts

1. **Lead (`start`).** A `--image-xs` (`20px`) slot: a `subtlest` clock when `queued`, a `ProgressRing` when `uploading`, a danger icon on `error`, a folder icon when `kind="folder"` is `done`, or the matching file-type icon when `kind="file"` is `done`.
2. **Name (`label`).** Single-line name that truncates before the extension so `.mp4` or `.pdf` remains readable, wrapped in a `Tooltip` with the full name. Opens via `Link` when `href` is set on a `done` item.
3. **Meta (`description`).** Single-line secondary status: `Waiting` when `queued`, `Uploading · <n>%` when `uploading`, `meta` (or `Uploaded`) when `done`, and the `error` message in danger text on `error`.
4. **Actions (`end`).** Omitted when `isReadOnly` or `isDisabled`. Draws a compact subtle X `IconButton` for `cancel` and `remove`, or a trash `IconButton` that confirms via `Popup` for `delete`. On `error`, a compact subtle `Retry` `Button` precedes the X control.

### States

| State | What changes |
| --- | --- |
| Queued | Clock icon in `--ds-icon-subtlest`, `Waiting` in `--ds-text-subtle`, and Cancel X. |
| Uploading | `ProgressRing` at `--image-xs`, `Uploading · &lt;n&gt;%` in `--ds-text-subtle`, and Cancel X. |
| Done | File-type or folder icon in `--ds-icon-subtle`, `meta` (size, count, or date), optional `href` link, and Remove X or Delete trash with confirmation. |
| Error | Danger icon in `--ds-icon-danger`, cause-and-fix message in `--ds-text-danger`, and `Retry` before Remove X. |
| Read-only | Full contrast and openable `href` link, with all end actions hidden. |
| Disabled | `--ds-background-disabled`, `--ds-border-disabled`, and `--ds-text-disabled`; end actions hidden and links disabled. |

## Content guidelines

| Do | Don't |
| --- | --- |
| Keep the real file name and extension intact so middle truncation preserves the type. | Strip the extension from `name`. |
| Write error messages with cause and fix: "Connection dropped. Check your network and retry." | "Error" or "Failed". |
| Include file count on folders: "6 files · 142 MB". | Show a folder name with no count. |

## Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|------|------|---------|-------------|
| `name` | string (required) | — | File or folder display name. Truncates in the middle so the extension stays visible, with the full name in a tooltip. |
| `meta` | node | — | Secondary metadata such as file size (`"14.2 MB"`), folder item count (`"6 files"`), or saved date (`"Added Nov 12"`). |
| `status` | enum | — | Current upload lifecycle state of the item. |
| `progress` | number | — | Upload percent from 0 to 100 while `status` is `uploading`. |
| `error` | node | — | One-sentence cause and fix shown on `status="error"`. |
| `kind` | enum | `'file'` | `file` (default) or `folder` (uses the folder icon when done and shows file count in `meta`). |
| `fileType` | string | — | Explicit file category or extension (`pdf`, `video`, `audio`, `image`, `archive`, `word`, `spreadsheet`, `presentation`, `code`, `text`, `file`). Inferred from `name` when omitted. |
| `removal` | enum | — | `cancel` (in-flight upload X), `remove` (unsaved form X), or `delete` (saved attachment trash icon that confirms first). |
| `onRemove` | func | — | Called when the user cancels, removes, or confirms deleting the item. |
| `onRetry` | func | — | Called when the user presses Retry on an `error` item. |
| `href` | string | — | Destination URL that opens a completed (`status="done"`) file. |
| `isReadOnly` | bool | `false` | Hides all end actions while keeping full contrast, for read-only views and static attachments. |
| `isDisabled` | bool | `false` | Hides end actions, disables opening links, and dims the row. |
| `id` | string | — | Element id on the row container. |
| `className` | string | `''` | Extra class names added to the row container. |
